name: comp-333
title: Command Palette Search
blurb: Keyboard-accessible command palette with search and grouped actions.
description: A shadcn CommandDialog triggered by Cmd+K, with searchable commands grouped by Quick Start and Navigation, showing keyboard shortcuts.
use_when: Providing power-users with keyboard-driven access to app actions and navigation.
avoid_when: For touch-only interfaces — the Cmd+K shortcut is desktop-only.
a11y: CommandDialog provides full keyboard navigation; input auto-focused on open; icons are aria-hidden; shortcuts displayed visually.
